label: PERSONAL & PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT · NICE
title:
Find your balance.
Open up new possibilities.
intro: In Nice, Valérie Migueres offers personalised support through stress, self-doubt and change, bringing your personal wellbeing and professional aspirations into focus.
ambience: A light-filled interior with natural materials, an illustrative atmosphere image
caption: Light, space, a moment to breathe. Illustrative image.
needs_intro: You don’t need to know exactly where you’re heading. We can begin with what you are experiencing today.
support_intros: When self-doubt takes over or everyday life feels overwhelming, find steadier ground and a kinder relationship with yourself.
Change can unsettle familiar routines. Take time to understand what matters and consider what comes next.
Reflect on your career, clarify your aspirations and shape a direction that feels right for you.
Find your place, prepare for an important milestone and move at your own pace, with support suited to your age and needs.
Create space for reflection and conversation around stress, confidence and professional transitions.
situations: You question your abilities or your place.
Stress and mental overload affect your everyday life.
You want to set boundaries and find balance.
You are going through a separation or a new stage of life.
Your familiar reference points are changing.
You want to make choices that reflect your priorities.
You are considering a career change or a new role.
You want to understand your skills and motivations.
You are looking for a healthier relationship between work and personal life.
Exams or decisions about your future feel daunting.
You would like to build your confidence.
You are moving into higher education or working life.
Your teams are facing stress or change.
You would like to offer a confidence workshop.
You need support shaped around your organisation.
work: Self-esteem, personal boundaries, stress and everyday resources.
Needs, emotions, priorities and the next steps in your transition.

Values, skills, motivations and possible career directions. Career review — bilan de compétences is a structured exploration of your experience and professional plans within the French context. Its scope is agreed before any commitment; it is not presented as an overseas qualification.
Confidence, organisation, exam preparation and decisions about education. The framework for supporting minors is agreed with their legal guardians.
Workshops on stress, confidence and professional transitions. The format, objectives and arrangements are developed with you.
tools_intro: The choice of tools depends on your situation, preferences and the agreed framework. We take time to discuss it together.
tools: An approach drawing on attention and imagination to explore different ways of experiencing a situation.
Work focused on a current difficulty, your resources and the changes you would like to consider.
Ways to observe connections between thoughts, feelings and behaviours, and try different responses.
A method providing feedback on recorded brain activity. Its suitability and practical arrangements are discussed within the proposed framework.
Space to clarify goals, recognise resources and put decisions into action.
approach_intro: Everyone brings a different story. My approach begins with listening, understanding your needs and agreeing a framework that feels comfortable. The tools evolve with our work, in conversation with you.
medical: This support does not replace medical care when it is needed.
subtitle: An integrative approach combining hypnotherapy, brief therapies, coaching and neurofeedback.
about_intro: In Nice, Valérie Migueres offers space to put your experience into words, gain perspective and explore your next steps. The work develops through dialogue and respect for your pace.
steps_title: What does working together look like?
steps: An initial conversation to understand your situation and what brings you here.
Together, we clarify your priorities, goals and the framework for our work.
We adapt as we go and regularly reflect on what is proving useful.
fees_intro: The programmes offer an indicative structure and can be personalised. We discuss your needs before agreeing an appropriate framework.
provisional: Provisional fees, to be confirmed before any commitment.
enquire: Career review — bilan de compétences & organisations: please enquire.
faq: Do I need to know exactly what I need?
No. You can begin with a situation, a question or a sense that something is difficult. We will clarify your needs together.
The choice depends on your needs and the agreed framework. No technique is used automatically.
How many sessions should I expect?
We agree the pace and number of sessions together, and review them as we go. The programmes shown are indicative.
Please confirm consultation languages when you get in touch. An English website does not imply that sessions are available in English.
